uncultured.status: VEIN CONFIRMED WITHIN MEDIA CLASS · NOT GENERALIZED
uncultured.finding: A 2016 Facebook screenshot preserves full thread context, reactions, timestamps, nested replies and phone UI instead of isolating a single sentence. This pushes the context-preserving capture habit back at least one year within the same platform family.
uncultured.candidate: Context-preserving screenshot capture is a stable Facebook-era archival habit candidate, but still media-specific rather than a general visual grammar.
uncultured.next: seek screenshots from non-Facebook apps, years and purposes

terminus.finding: A 2008 heritage-management paper by Fang-Chieh Jung and Chao-Ching Fu argues that ROT/OT outsourcing mechanisms, because they were not designed specifically for heritage preservation, can lead to different management outcomes. This is a useful counterexample to the simple claim that tools can change while functions remain unchanged.
terminus.candidate: Refined vein: some tools are merely replaceable channels, but some institutional instruments carry their own logic and therefore reshape the function they are supposed to serve.
terminus.next: distinguish channel substitution from institutional redesign across unrelated cases

phase: small-batch mining with provenance-first, genre-aware scoring, media-class separation and active falsification
